name: jukebox-ios
description: juke.sh native iOS app (Tish staticlib + Xcode shell)

scripts.build: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../tish/tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust --crate-type staticlib --ios-triple aarch64-apple-ios-sim src/main.tish -o dist/jukebox-ios
scripts.build:device: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../tish/tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust --crate-type staticlib --ios-triple aarch64-apple-ios src/main.tish -o dist/jukebox-ios
